abi_status: target ABI: the current source-derived ops.json intentionally remains the 9-input/2-output official-C8 closure with both P9 macros disabled; this contract is activated only by the atomic host/kernel/bridge ABI change

source_derived_from.topk_owner: official ProcessTopK selection and original writeback are unchanged; P9 inserts only compile-disabled tails after each original writeback

resource_model.worker_assignment: any C8 worker may dynamically acquire an invocation-local queue

canonical_resident_layout.meaning: caller-reserved normal-resident row-major ranges; all four words are nonnegative int32, slots_per_row must be 2048, and row_count is widened to uint32 only after host validation

candidate_seed.slot_assignment: one candidate receives one distinct fixed resident slot before PostOnly

maps.candidate_source_to_slot: int32[R, S], initialized to -1; written only after the fully published descriptor is accepted by PostOnly
maps.candidate_slot_cursor: int32[R], invocation-local monotonic admission cursor; it only prevents duplicate initial posts and is not used for Stage-B reuse

candidate_seed.cross_wave_slot_invariant: CandidateCompact never assigns one resident_slot to two initial waves; Stage-B drains every initial wave before it may reuse a non-winner slot for exact recall

stage_a.name: score_scan_candidate_post
stage_a.rule: observe exact tile scores, compact only cold candidates, and PostOnly to the supplied fixed resident slot without modifying official C8 score or Top-K state

stage_b.name: topk_recall_and_terminal_drain
stage_b.qsfa_contract: QSFA consumes only final attention_slots after this condition holds
